text:
emma: Bringing in 'pegasus-mini-3B' for a latency-sensitive summarization route. Need a quant plan + quick smoke eval. Who can own the intake this week?

raj: I can take the lead. Quick Q: are we optimizing for p99 latency or sustained throughput for this route?

emma: p99 latency is the priority (SLO 150ms for 512 tokens), but cost still matters — target is ~2-3x cheaper than fp16 hosting.

raj: ok. proposed fast path: 1) try int8 symmetric per-channel with bias correction; 2) fallback profile fp8 hybrid if int8 fails BLEU/ROUGE thresholds; 3) gguf artifact for distro.

sophia: note from previous 3B bringups: int8 micro-casts had layer-wise spike on layer 8 for this arch. Guard with per-layer calibration thresholds. Also use a small, diverse calib set (docs + chat + code) — pegasus is sensitive to long sentences.

mike: throwing a compact checklist here to run tonight (keeps things actionable):
- pick calib set (<=2k examples)
- run per-layer sensitivity sweep (N=3 seeds)
- compute ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 (accept if <=0.8% absolute)
- perf smoke: single-request p99 + 32-concurrent throughput
- if int8 fails, run fp8-hybrid w/ KV-cache skip

raj: calib config I'm going to use (running now):
```
quant_profile:
  target_precision: int8
  per_channel: true
  bias_correction: true
  fallback: fp8-hybrid
  calib_set_path: s3://redwood-calib/pegasus-mini/1000-sample.jsonl
  batch_size: 8
  seeds: [42, 7, 123]
```

emma: thanks. please post quick sample outputs (edge cases) — especially very long paragraphs and bullet lists.

quant-bot: scheduled calib job created: job_id=54832, owner=raj, eta=42m, infra=dedi-gpu-pool-3 

mike: reminder: for p99 we should test with kv-cache warmup scenarios. small perf note: batching helps cost but can break p99 — record both single-request and micro-batched p99.

raj: initial smoke results (seed=42, 1k calib, int8):
- ROUGE-L delta vs fp16: -0.45%
- EM-like exact matches: -0.6%
- sample failure mode: hallucinated date in 2/100 samples (short factuals)
- single-request p99 (512 tokens): 138ms
- 32-concurrent throughput: 240 reqs/s (avg)

sophia: that's promising. low-quality failure mode -> add targeted calibration examples with date-anchored sentences, and rerun per-layer clamp on problematic layers.

raj: re-ran per-layer clamp and bias-correction tuning. new int8 stats: ROUGE-L delta -0.15%, p99 142ms. Hallucinations dropped to 0.8% in failure buckets after adding 150 targeted strings.

emma: solid. action items:
- raj: promote int8 profile to canary on a small % of traffic with auto-fallback to fp8-hybrid for policy violations (owner: raj)
- mike: create perf dashboard for that route showing p50/p90/p99 + cost per 1k tokens (owner: mike)
- sophia: add the targeted calibration examples to the onboarding corpus and add a note about layer-8 sensitivity (owner: sophia)

emma: timeline?

raj: canary tomorrow morning PST, monitor first 2 hours closely. will post rollout notes and a short eval snippet.

quant-bot: canary rollout scheduled: rollout_id=canary-pegasus-3b-01, start=2978080000, percent=5%

mike: I'll wire up alerts: p99 > 180ms, rouge-L drop > 1.2%, hallucination rate > 1.5% -> rollback.

emma: perfect. thanks everyone. will follow up in #eng-ml with results. :rocket:
